contract.task_clause:
All of the following statements are true for all discrete random variables except for which one?
Option A: The possible outcomes must all be numerical.
Option B: The possible outcomes must be mutually exclusive.
Option C: The mean (expected value) always equals the sum of the products obtained by multiplying each value by its corresponding probability.
Option D: Approximately 95% of the outcomes will be within two standard deviations of the mean.
